content: स्नेहः [स्निह्-घञ्] .²1 Affection, love, kindness, tenderness; स्नेहदाक्षिण्ययोर्योगात् कामीव प्रतिभाति मे <ls>V. 2. 4</ls> (where it has sense 6 also); अस्ति मे सोदरस्नेहोऽप्येतेषु <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²2 Oiliness, visicidity, unctuousness, lubricity (one of the 24 Guṇas according to the Vaiśeṣikas) .²3 Moisture; तृष्णासंजननं स्नेह एष तेषां पुनर्भवः <ls>Mb. 12. 218. 33</ls>. .²4 Grease, fat, any unctuous substance. .²5 Oil; निर्विष्टविषयस्नेहः स दशान्तमुपेयिवान् <ls>R. 12. 1</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 82</ls> (where the word has sense 1 also), <ls n="Pt. 1.">221</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 75</ls>. .²6 Any fluid of the body, such as semen.
